# Retained upstream texts

These are unmodified upstream license/notice texts, not a license invented for dependencies. The build also records each package's own declared license, authors and copyright from its public NuGet specification, and retains package-provided texts verbatim.

| File | Retrieved source | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dotnet-MIT.txt` | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dotnet/efcore/v10.0.14/LICENSE.txt | `ae48df11a335dc1a615f4f938b69cba73bcf4485c4f97af49b38efb0f216353b` |
| `SQLitePCLRaw-LICENSE.txt` | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ericsink/SQLitePCL.raw/main/LICENSE.TXT | `cfc7749b96f63bd31c3c42b5c471bf756814053e847c10f3eb003417bc523d30` |
| `SQLitePCLRaw-NOTICE.txt` | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ericsink/SQLitePCL.raw/main/NOTICE.TXT | `5a1ab2f670f86dd2f8d42e40a8459cc278ca6d5225a7e2a5fa3ea0184396a6d9` |

Retrieved 2026-11-10. SQLitePCLRaw 2.1.13 packages declare Apache-2.0 and SourceGear copyright but omit standalone texts; the retained upstream NOTICE also preserves SQLite's public-domain notice. The main-branch source above is provenance for these exact retained bytes, not a claim that a nonexistent `v2.1.13` Git tag was verified.

Garmin's SDK license is copied from the exact restored `Garmin.FIT.Sdk/21.221.0` package. Its redistribution conditions are separate from MIT; keeping its text is not independent legal clearance. Base-image framework/OS notices are retained in the upstream images and must also be considered when distributing an image.
